description: This source file defines a utility object SplitUtils that provides functions to split a string into tokens based on spaces and adds valid tokens to a linked list.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: Utility object providing string splitting functions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them in a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it is valid (non-empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
